purpose: fair-CMA control vs adversarial finding cma-starved-too-few-generations
configs: cma_pop6_b30 (fair popsize 6, equal budget 30, graded penalty)
conclusion: At equal budget a fair-popsize CMA reaches only 5/10 marginal (vs surrogate 9/10). With 2x budget fair-CMA reaches 9/10 too -> the REACH gap was partly a budget artifact. BUT the EFFICIENCY gap is robust: fair-CMA needs median 26 expensive solves vs the surrogate's 6 (~4x) -> NOT a starvation artifact. The contribution is solve-EFFICIENCY, not unique capability.
